name: emsc_quakes
why: Earthquake list from a non-profit research centre; new events insert rows at the top during a visit, pushing the links below them down.

name: emsc_realtime
why: EMSC real-time seismic map; new events are added as they arrive, and the event list beside the map re-renders.

name: iris_seismon
why: IRIS/EarthScope seismic monitor (ds.iris.edu/seismon redirects here); quake markers and the list refresh, and the map lays out after load.

name: faa_nas
why: FAA National Airspace System status; airport delay entries load after the page opens and change as delays are posted.

name: eia_grid
why: EIA hourly grid monitor (open data); chart panels and their controls load one after another, shifting the layout after load.

name: caiso_outlook
why: California grid operator's live supply and demand charts; the panels load late and refresh on a timer.

name: ercot_dash
why: Texas grid operator's dashboards; live tiles load after the page opens and update in place.

name: owid
why: Our World in Data front page (CC BY); lazily loaded charts and featured cards resize the page after load.

name: wikimedia_status
why: Wikimedia status page; the uptime bars and metric charts render after load and move the component links.

name: python_status
why: Python infrastructure status page (open source); components and incident history render after load.

name: github_status
why: GitHub status page; incident banners can appear at the top and push every link down.

name: voa_news
why: Voice of America front page (US public broadcaster); carousels rotate and lazily loaded blocks shift the links.

name: wikinews
why: Wikinews main page (Wikimedia); a mostly static control page with a few late-loading elements.

name: weather_gov
why: National Weather Service front page; the hazard map and its legend links load after the page opens.

name: usgs_water
why: USGS National Water Dashboard; map markers and panels load progressively and the layout settles late.

name: usgs_volcanoes
why: USGS volcano notices; the notice list and map load after the page opens.

name: airnow
why: EPA AirNow; the location widget and air-quality map load late, and a slideshow rotates.

name: esa
why: European Space Agency front page; a hero carousel rotates its links (robots.txt asks for a 2 s crawl delay, below our 10 s).

name: un
why: United Nations front page; a rotating hero slider and late-loading news blocks (robots.txt asks for a 10 s crawl delay, which equals our minimum).

name: nhc
why: National Hurricane Center; outlook graphics and the active-storm links load late; mostly static outside storm season.

name: hydra_nixos
why: NixOS build farm front page (open source); the queue and build counts change between loads (robots.txt allows only the root URL, the only page we load).
